release_notes:
🚀 Azkar 1.3.3 Is Here!

- 🔄 Core Sync Fix: Resolves issue where checkmarks (Morning/Evening) weren't properly resetting on a new day or were overridden by outdated cloud data.
- 📱 New 2x2 Square Widget: A beautiful compact tracker for your home screen to see your progress at a glance!
- 🛠️ Architecture & Build stability upgrades.
